name: @psyb0t/mailbox
summary: Wire an OpenClaw agent to a self-hosted docker-mailbox IMAP/SMTP control plane over MCP — read, search, triage, draft, reply and send mail across multiple inboxes with scoped tokens.
description: A thin stdio<->HTTP bridge that connects an MCP client (OpenClaw, Claude, Cursor, Codex, ...) to a running docker-mailbox instance's MCP endpoint (/mcp), exposing its tools: mailboxes (discovery), inbox (unified cross-account read), list_folders, list_messages, search, get_message, get_raw_message, get_attachment, get_thread, set_labels, move_messages, create_draft, reply, send, send_draft, delete_message (to Trash) and mark_seen, filtered by the token's scopes. docker-mailbox is a multi-mailbox IMAP/SMTP control plane exposed as a REST API + MCP server on a single port. It is self-hosted — you run the server yourself and point this bridge at it. See https://github.com/psyb0t/docker-mailbox.

MAILBOX_URL.description: Base URL of your running mailboxd server, e.g. http://localhost:8000 (the bridge appends /mcp).

MAILBOX_TOKEN.description: Bearer token configured on the server (its scopes decide which tools appear).

url.description: Base URL of your running mailboxd server, e.g. http://localhost:8000 (the bridge appends /mcp).

token.description: Bearer token matching the server's auth.tokens.
